heading: Definitions
lead: For the purposes of this subchapter:

tree.heading: Controlled substance
tree.text: The term “controlled substance” has the meaning given such term in section 802 of title 21.

tree.heading: Drug-related crime
tree.text: The term “drug-related crime” means the illegal manufacture, sale, distribution, use, or possession with intent to manufacture, sell, distribute, or use a controlled substance.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Housing and Urban Development.

tree.heading: Federally assisted low-income housing
tree.text: The term “federally assisted low-income housing” means housing assisted under—

tree.heading: Recipient
tree.text: The term “recipient”, when used in reference to the Native American Housing Assistance and Self-Determination Act of 1996 [25 U.S.C. 4101 et seq.], has the meaning given such term in section 4 of such Act [25 U.S.C. 4103].

tree.heading: Indian tribe
tree.text: The term “Indian tribe” has the meaning given the term in section 4(12) 1 of the Native American Housing Assistance and Self Determination Act of 1996, 25 U.S.C. 4103(12).
